One End Is Not Square

SSF-MS8-L1-10001300-MSMATH8-DBT-GBL
THE DIRECTIONS
You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.
The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.
The field plan
As you record, the four lengths fill in. Each end goes corner to corner. Square and add to check.

THE SCENE
Schools from six countries came to your school for the final game. It will be played on your soccer field today. You are in a debate about that field. Your side says the lines must be checked and fixed first. The other side says there is no time. A field is fair only if the corners are square corners. You must check both ends of the field. Four people each have one length you need.
THE HISTORY
Builders long ago made square corners with a rope. The rope had knots at 3, 4, and 5 steps. India, China, and Babylon all wrote down the same rule. Today the same check marks a soccer field.
